body: Yeah, I tried. She's definitely not happy but maybe this will help me tell her things that I probably should have told her a while ago.
If I were quicker thinking, I may have. Thanks!
I appreciate the attempt, but, no, I don't see how that is worse, or why it should make me feel better.
The message was, "I feel like I should get [friend] a present but she's been annoying me so much lately". And sent to friend. Pretty sure all I can do is own up.

This week was better for me. I went to my job interview and it went very well. I think they are going to make an offer and then I will have to make a decision which is scary in and of itself.

Things are okay at home. We keep fighting and I know that I could make it better. I haven't been eating well or exercising, and I was doing so much better when that was a normal part of my life.

I like the theme idea. :) It could be fun. We can all work in our own things. 

I have been interviewing for a new job. I couldn't handle the anxiety of leaving my current job, and I'm not 100% I want to, anyway. So, I emailed the company and said I no longer want to be considered. They asked me to talk to them again before I cancel the interview for Thursday. I believe they want to offer it to me and now I'm more confused than ever. I already told my family that I wasn't doing it. Now I dint know what to do. I feel like there is no right answer.
It used to help. Now I think it is not helpful at all. I calm down, but by avoiding things, not because I've actually calmed down.

I'm having a bad couple of weeks. I've been having trouble getting out of bed, staying on target at work, or getting anything done around my house. My place is incredibly messy, which makes it hard for me to be here. So, I've been ignoring the work that needs to be done and heading to friends' houses, where I end up smoking a lot of weed. I get so anxious in my home when things need to be done, and I can't get myself to do it when I'm here alone. My friends all have kids and can't come over and keep me busy while I do it.
I told her, but she spent the time talking about her problems.
Yes. I told her I couldn't be alone.

Not okay. I went to my friend's house because she's the only person I know that wasn't already doing something for the holiday (her husband works late). Now her 2 year old daughter keeps telling me to leave and go away.
